title: Ohm Brew Slush Brew Green Mix 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Green Mix from Ohm Brew’s Slush Brew collection delivers a mouth-watering rush of Sour Apple and zingy, zesty Lime flavour in a syrupy-sweet and utterly moreish Slushy. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
